Key Capabilities:
Media Monitoring: Meltwater’s media intelligence platform monitors and analyzes media coverage through tracking brand mentions across news, print, broadcast, podcasts, and social media. 

Social Listening: Meltwater’s social listening and analytics platform monitors 200B+ conversations and analyzes 300M+ profiles to deliver a real-time view of brand, consumer, and competitor dynamics. 
AI Visibility Tracking: Analyze how top LLMs and AI networks, like ChatGPT and Google Gemini, portray your brand by reviewing their responses and the sources they cite. 

Influencer Management: Meltwater’s influencer discovery and relationship management platform enables teams to vet, manage, and measure campaigns at scale in one place.

name: NationBuilding Foundation of India
d:
India has made significant progress over the past several decades. However, as the country grows, new challenges emerge, and existing systems continue to leave room for change & improvement.

We believe that NationBuilding can be a common purpose around which people can come together to improve the society they are part of. Alongside thinking about what needs to change and how to change it, it is also about taking responsibility and taking action to make that change happen. It is driven by the urge to see society improve and the belief that everyone can be a changemaker. It is about contributing to making the nation better and leaving it better than we found it. 

Within this concept, the NationBuilding Foundation of India (NBFI) is envisioned to operate not simply as a think tank, but as a do-tank. The Foundation aspires to create platforms that enable people to contribute to NationBuilding by turning their ideas, ambition, and intent into action. It aims to work at multiple levels, including building responsible and engaged citizens, creating pathways for high-capability talent to contribute to NationBuilding, working with industry practitioners to address problems in priority sectors, and engaging with leaders, policymakers, and government institutions on policy and implementation.

A central part of this approach is the involvement of young people because of their ambition, audacity for change, and willingness to challenge existing ways of doing things. NBFI seeks to give this energy a platform with the aim of enabling some of India's most ambitious young people to contribute directly to NationBuilding and become leaders of change.

name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
d:
Launched in 2006, Amazon Web Services (AWS) began exposing key infrastructure services to businesses in the form of web services -- now widely known as cloud computing. The ultimate benefit of cloud computing, and AWS, is the ability to leverage a new business model and turn capital infrastructure expenses into variable costs. Businesses no longer need to plan and procure servers and other IT resources weeks or months in advance. Using AWS, businesses can take advantage of Amazon's expertise and economies of scale to access resources when their business needs them, delivering results faster and at a lower cost.

Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. With data center locations in the U.S., Europe, Singapore, and Japan, customers across all industries are taking advantage of our low cost, elastic, open and flexible, secure platform.

d:

Our platform utilizes data from multiple (tens or even hundreds of) sources to identify anomalies and flag sub-optimal operations based on the underlying relationships among variables. 

The analytical sophistication of the platform is further enhanced with the integration of physics-based performance models that augment the AI models providing richer insights into machine performance and health. Our built-in algorithms target specific use cases such as performance degradation, machine vibrations, dry gas seal health, motor insulation health, gas contamination, and several others. This targeted approach has allowed us to detect machine issues that had previously gone undetected by other remote monitoring and diagnostic providers on the same machines.

Our platform's remote monitoring provides deep insights into plant anomalies to ensure operational reliability resulting in significant cost savings for our customers.

We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.

We integrate insights from across the value chain - Pricing, Distribution, Shelf Execution, Paid Media, and Category strategy to identify the influencing levers that move the needle most. 

Our three primary solutions are:
Revstack: Market intelligence that connects category, competition and brand data with digital shelf metrics to correlate revenue performance with pricing, availability, visibility and retail readiness.
Reviniti: Ads automation that eliminates manual media execution at scale. Runs rule-based automations across bids, budgets and targets, scaling what works, cutting what doesn't - without human intervention.
Revsight: One integrated dashboard across revenue, media and supply data. Correlates SoV, availability, pricing and content across platforms and geographies so teams move from data to action faster.

We work with Unilever, Coca-Cola, Unicharm, Nestle, Pepsi, Nivea, Philips, HP, Marico, Dabur, Tata Consumer and 150+ other brands.

The numbers don't lie:

Reliable .  Safe . Efficient

It also gives customers the flexibility to run their workloads wherever they need by supporting public cloud, multicloud, hybrid cloud, sovereign, and on-premises deployments.

The Oracle AI Database is the only database with AI natively built in everywhere. By bringing AI to where data lives, the Oracle AI Database delivers enterprise-grade AI securely, cost-effectively, and at scale. In-database machine learning and vector search enable AI models to run where data resides. Support for multi-modal data (structured, unstructured, graph, vector) enables richer AI use cases. 

The Oracle AI Data Platform enables organizations to build, deploy, and govern AI agents and applications on top of private, secure, and distributed enterprise data. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control. 

Oracle Applications embed AI directly into business workflows and industry processes to ensure AI is delivered in context, where work happens. They include the only applications suite that brings AI to every aspect of a business, with AI-powered ERP, HCM, and CX applications, and the Oracle Health Suite which provides applications for managing the entire healthcare ecosystem. d:
IDENA est une entreprise indépendante, appartenant à ses salariés. Ceci est un gage de dynamisme, de combativité et de force d'écoute pour le client, ce que nous cultivons depuis la création de la société. Notre motivation est la passion de notre métier de la nutrition animale et de l'innovation.

IDENA : Innovation et Développement En Nutrition Animale

Dans un monde qui change, notre finalité d'entreprise est d'innover POUR CONCEVOIR AUTREMENT L'ALIMENTATION DES ANIMAUX, améliorer les performances techniques et économiques dans le respect du bien-être animal et de l'environnement, pour sans cesse générer les produits alimentaires de qualité des différentes filières professionnelles (fabricants d'aliments, couvoirs, abattoirs, laiteries, éleveurs...).

Composé d'experts consultants spécialisés par espèces, le groupe IDENA est constitué de sociétés recouvrant la R&D, l'ingénierie de nutrition animale et la fabrication de pré-mélanges et spécialités innovantes.

Née en 1995, en plein contexte compliqué de « crise de la vache folle » en Europe, IDENA a intégré dans ses gènes depuis le début la nécessité d'innover dans des solutions alternatives pour offrir au marché de la nutrition animale des solutions différentes, plus saines, plus sécurisées.

En 2002, après avoir structuré et construit les premières bases de sa R&D, IDENA crée son propre site industriel, à Pontchâteau (44), avec la construction d'une usine différente de celles traditionnelles du marché, dans le même objectif d'offrir au marché un outil industriel plus sûr, plus sécurisé.

Les années 2000 verront l'internationalisation de l'activité du Groupe.

Aujourd'hui, IDENA offre ses services à plus de deux cents clients fabricants d'aliments ou acteurs des filières animales, répartis entre la France, pays d'origine, et l'International (présence dans plus de 40 pays sur les 5 continents).

Sites web : 
http://www.idena.fr/

d:
IFCI Ltd. was set up in 1948 as Industrial Finance Corporation of India, a Statutory Corporation, through `The Industrial Finance Corporation of India Act, 1948’ of Parliament to provide medium and long term finance to industry. After repeal of this Act in 1993, IFCI became a Public Limited Company registered under the Companies Act, 1956. IFCI became a Government controlled company subsequent to enhancement of equity shareholding to 55.53% by Government of India on December 21, 2012. In April, 2015, Government of India has acquired six crore Preference Shares of IFCI Ltd. of Rs.10/- each from six public sector banks.With this, the shareholding of the Government of India in paid-up share capital of IFCI has been increased to 51.04% and IFCI has become a Government Company under Section 2(45) of the Companies Act, 2013. IFCI is also a Systemically Important Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC-ND-SI), registered with the Reserve Bank of India.
Its main products are 
A. Term Loans
B. Corporate Loans
C. Short Term Loans (up to 1 year)
D. Loan against Shares
E. Loans to NBFC's

name: RediMinds, Inc
d:
RediMinds builds trusted decision infrastructure for healthcare.
 
Founded in 2016, we develop AI-enabled systems that help healthcare experts review complex evidence, identify what matters, and make faster, more consistent, better-supported decisions. Our platforms bring structure, clarity, and traceability to workflows that are often manual, document-heavy, and difficult to audit.
 
Our technology supports independent medical review, independent dispute resolution, workers’ compensation review, prior authorization, disability determinations, clinician credentialing, and other federal and state healthcare decision processes. AI helps organize records and surface relevant evidence, while qualified professionals remain accountable for every final decision.
 
We pair advanced technology with genuine domain expertise. Our network includes independent physicians and dentists across more than 50 specialties, as well as experienced arbitrators, helping ensure each determination is grounded in the appropriate clinical and subject-matter expertise.
 
Trust is foundational to how we build and operate. RediMinds maintains SOC 2 attestation and HITRUST certification, follows HIPAA privacy and security requirements, and holds URAC IRO Accreditation. We are also proud to be one of the first three organizations to earn URAC’s Health Care AI Accreditation, reflecting our commitment to strong governance and the responsible use of AI.
 
We are building the future of trusted, defensible healthcare decisions.

name: Tattva Education Technologies Pvt Ltd
d:
Tattva Education Technologies is building India's first cognitive learning operating system for high-stakes exam preparation — starting with UPSC Civil Services.
We solve a structurally broken problem: 13 lakh aspirants spend ₹1.2 lakh or more every year on coaching, content, and test series — but no system tells them what's actually working.
Effort and outcome are completely decoupled. The feedback loop is missing.

Tattva closes that loop.

Our platform continuously diagnoses how each aspirant thinks and where they are stuck, prescribes a personalised daily study plan with no planning burden on the student, reinforces learning through spaced retrieval so coverage becomes mastery — not familiarity, and measures real score improvement velocity — not just engagement metrics.

The result is a system that improves with every interaction. The more a student uses it, the smarter it gets about what they need. That compounding data advantage is our moat.

We are not an edtech company. We are building the infrastructure layer that makes learning work.

Started in 2020, Social Bird grew out of late-night ideas, random sparks of creativity, and a simple belief that marketing works best when it doesn’t feel like marketing. Today, that energy still runs the place. Our office is less “boardroom” and more “brainstorm over chai and maggi,” where the best ideas usually come mid-conversation, not from a presentation slide.

We work with creators across the spectrum, matching the right voices with the right brands so it never feels off. From influencer campaigns and meme marketing to PR, ORM, and digital, everything we do is rooted in how people actually behave online. If it doesn’t feel real, we don’t do it.

There’s always a bit of chaos, a lot of laughter and a team that genuinely enjoys the process. It feels less like work, more like building something together. And that shows in what we create.

For brands, we make sure you don’t just show up, you stand out without trying too hard. For creators, we open doors that actually lead somewhere.

If you’re looking for marketing that feels like a conversation, not a pitch, you’ll fit right in.

d:
UniCoach is an international education and student mobility platform designed to simplify the journey from choosing the right course to building a successful career abroad. Positioned as a strong alternative to large education platforms such as LeapScholar and ApplyBoard, UniCoach combines technology, personalised counselling, application support, career guidance, visa assistance, and post-study planning in one connected student experience. The platform is built around a simple idea: international education decisions should not be based only on university rankings or admission probability, but on the student’s long-term academic, financial, immigration, and career goals.

At the core of UniCoach is personalised student profiling. Instead of immediately recommending universities, the platform first evaluates a student’s academic background, professional experience, career interests, budget, preferred countries, immigration goals, and future employment prospects. This allows UniCoach to recommend courses and destinations that are relevant to the individual rather than simply promoting institutions with available seats. The objective is to help students make informed choices that are realistic, financially sensible, and aligned with their long-term ambitions.

Course and university selection is one of the most important stages of the international education journey. UniCoach helps students compare programmes based on entry requirements, tuition fees, location, academic content, scholarship opportunities, graduate outcomes, and career relevance. Students can receive structured guidance on whether a programme represents genuine progression from their previous studies and whether it supports their intended career direction. This is particularly important for students who are changing fields, applying after
